# Synthetic Legal Metrology Reference (TEST/DEMO MATERIAL)

NOTE: This is synthetic data for testing purposes only and does not represent actual government law.

## Section 1: Instrument Tolerances
All commercial weighing instruments must operate within the Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) defined for their accuracy class. Class III instruments have an MPE of ± 1d for loads up to 500d.

## Section 2: Re-verification Period
Standard commercial instruments must undergo re-verification every 12 months. Special industrial instruments may require 24-month cycles depending on the category.
